text: Three years ago, researchers at Vega Institute tested a simple idea. They gave 240 volunteers a short daily task. After 12 weeks, 68 percent reported better focus. The team says the effect may fade without practice. Could a five minute habit really change your attention? The data is promising but not conclusive.
